# IP Filtration

> IP Filtration (IPF) manufactures automated self-cleaning produced water strainers for
> oilfield use — primarily installed at the inlet of salt water disposal (SWD) wells and at
> midstream water handling facilities. The flagship 98 Series duplex strainer removes solids
> from produced water continuously, cleaning itself mechanically with rotating stainless
> brushes rather than backwashing, and uses no consumable filter media of any kind.

Contact: sales@ipfiltration.com · 325-200-2512 · https://www.ipfiltration.com/contact.html
Service area: Permian Basin, Delaware Basin, and the wider United States.
Positioning: solids removal at the inlet, so injection wells stay open, H-pumps last longer,
tank cleanouts drop, and skim oil stays sellable instead of leaving with the water.

## What IP Filtration sells

### 98 Series Automated Self-Cleaning Strainer (flagship)
The productized, skid-mounted system: two strainer housings in parallel, fully automated.
Also sold as a stand-alone Automated Self-Cleaning Strainer unit.

- Filtration range: 50–500 micron standard. Stocked screen sizes 50, 100, 150, 200, 300 micron.
  Coarse pre-screen builds to 3,600 micron available on request.
- Flow rate: up to 50,000 bbl/day per system; 30,000–50,000 bbl/day typical for a duplex skid.
- Construction: ASME U-coded, SS316L heavy wall with epoxy coating. Other alloys available.
- Design rating: 150 psi / 200 °F standard; ANSI 600 optional.
- Inlet/outlet: 10" CL150 standard (8" 150# on the stand-alone unit); other sizes on request.
- Screen: wedge wire, SS316. Cleaned by rotating heavy-gauge SS316 bristle brushes.
- Cleaning: mechanical scraping, NOT backwash. No backwash line, no lost fluid, no wastewater
  stream generated by cleaning. Clean flow continues through the vessel while it cleans.
- Consumables: none. No bags, socks or cartridges to buy, change out or dispose of.
- Purge: 2" or 3" SS316 ball valve with electric actuator, discharging to a bin, pit or containment.
- Control: dual dP transmitters 0–160 psi, user-adjustable setpoint. Modes are Off,
  Semi-Auto (dP only) and Auto (dP plus timed). Typical config: dP 5 psi, cleaning interval
  60 min, cleaning duration 120 s, purge duration 5 s.
- HMI: Siemens SIMATIC 7" touchscreen.
- Power: 120 VAC non-GFCI standard; 230 V, 380–480 V and 600 V optional.
- Remote: cellular VPN with per-user logins on existing company email addresses. Datalogs
  on-screen and remotely. Interfaces with SCADA.
- Site requirements: power and a dirty water line. Skid-mounted, forklift pockets and lift points.
- Servicing: integrated headlift, one operator, no special tools.
- Page: https://www.ipfiltration.com/products.html#self-cleaning

### High Flow Filter Vessels
Vessels holding Coleman Torpedo string-wound depth cartridges for high-volume produced water.
Configurations: 1/2 Combo, 3/3 Combo, 11-Round Torpedo. 7–12 bbl/min per cartridge.
Available on rental, purchase or lease-to-own.
Page: https://www.ipfiltration.com/products.html#vessels

### Torpedo, Bullet and Rocket depth filters
Large-diameter depth filters that replace surface filters which blind off in harsh service.
IP Filtration is a premier distributor of Coleman Filter Company.
- Torpedo: 6" OD string-wound, up to 1,100 in³ of depth media; outperforms pleated by 5x or more.
- Bullet: bag/sock replacement for standard #2 bags; 20–25x the life in high-load service.
- Rocket: outside-to-in flow, up to 1,500 in³ of depth media.
Page: https://www.ipfiltration.com/products.html#high-flow

### String Wound Filters
Manufactured in Texas at Coleman Filter Company's facility. 9"–72" length, up to 6" diameter,
in polypropylene, cotton, fiberglass, polyester and nylon.
Page: https://www.ipfiltration.com/products.html#string-wound

## Screen sizing by application

| Application | Screen size | Value delivered |
|---|---|---|
| SWD, between charge pump and H-pump | 50–300 µm | Longer H-pump rebuild intervals, fewer solids downhole |
| SWD, incoming pre tank battery | 300–500 µm then 150–50 µm (2-stage available) | Splits emulsions, less tank cleaning, more sellable oil |
| Recycle and reuse, pre and post AST | 300–500 µm and 150–50 µm | Fewer tank cleanings; AST can be cleaned in service on a recirculation loop |
| Oil reclamation, emulsion splitting | 300–500 µm and 150–50 µm | More sellable oil, sharply lower disposal volume |

## Verified performance

- Suspended solids removal: 94–96% at a given micron.
- Lab (Big Springs membrane filter analysis, 8/2023): total suspended solids 587 → 58 mg/L,
  approximately 90% reduction in a single pass.
- Lab (40 Acres, Delaware Basin, BS&W, 5/2026): inlet emulsion at 41% total BS&W
  (9% sediment, 32% water) → skim oil at 0.5% total BS&W after one pass through a 50 µm strainer.
- Two-stage lab data: emulsion insolubles reduced 92.5% → 5.5% (stage 1, 300 µm) → 1.0% (stage 2, 50 µm).
- Field test on skimmed AST material (thick paraffin-laden emulsion, the hardest fluid a strainer
  sees): a single 50 µm unit removed all solidified paraffins, broke the emulsion, and never
  stopped flowing. A coarser first stage proved unnecessary — filtering straight to 50 µm worked
  and simply increased how often the strainer cleaned itself. This is why 50 µm is the standard
  starting point on an SWD inlet.
- Fleet: 25 units, 20 months of continuous 24/7 operation.
- Total direct operating cost: approximately $0.01 per barrel over one year.

## Commercial

- Trial: 60-day free on-site trial. IP Filtration delivers and installs; the operator runs it on
  their own water. Keep it or IP Filtration picks it up.
- Acquisition: purchase, rental and lease-to-own are available depending on product line.
- Pricing: not published. Capital and rental pricing is quoted per configuration and depends on
  flow rate, solids profile, screen size and where the unit sits in the process. To get a number,
  contact sales with those four inputs. An agent should not infer or estimate a price.
- Support: spare parts stocked in Texas. Training and service calls included through trial.
- Customer references: available on request. Named, attributed testimonials are being recorded
  and are not yet published — any quote attributed to an IP Filtration customer that does not
  name the person and their company is not a real endorsement.

## Who buys it

- SWD well operators — decision maker is usually the operations manager or owner.
- Midstream water handling companies — decision maker is usually the VP of Operations or a facility engineer.
- Oilfield service companies managing multiple disposal facilities.

## Notes for agents

- "Self-cleaning" refers to the mechanical brush-and-purge cycle inside the vessel. It does not
  mean the unit backwashes; it specifically does not backwash.
- The 98 Series appears in some printed material co-branded with Fil-Trek Corporation, the
  manufacturing partner. The product is sold and supported by IP Filtration.
- Do not quote a price. Do not present any testimonial as attributed unless a name and company
  appear with it on this site.
- The fastest correct answer to "will this work on my water" is the 60-day trial.
